cases.name: covered CA main

cases.expected: assessment covered; redline; intentional failed validation; bounded repair; founder then lawyer; finalized, not published

cases.name: unknown/non-covered
cases.setup: unknown threshold or T03 non-covered fixture
cases.expected: needs_information preserves nulls OR closed_no_change narrowly scoped; no false compliance claim

cases.name: duplicate signup
cases.setup: repeat same source_event_id/key/hash concurrently
cases.expected: one event/workflow; same IDs returned; different payload with same key409

cases.name: out-of-order source

cases.expected: current facts remain v3; v2 audit flagged stale; no obsolete draft

cases.name: lease crash
cases.setup: worker dies after claim; second worker acquires later lease epoch
cases.expected: late first completion rejected; one committed output; budgets unchanged

cases.name: model timeout

cases.expected: reservation retained; capped retry; stale result discarded; no duplicate context mutation

cases.name: base conflict

cases.expected: no lawyer gate; no finalization; immutable audit distinguishes activity

cases.name: stale after text edit

cases.expected: both old gates inactive; new validation and founder review required; stale409

cases.name: fact/source write skew

cases.name: repair exhaustion

cases.name: feedback separation

cases.name: unknown delivery window

cases.name: webhook duplicates/order

cases.expected: previewed has no provider call; real send needs actual provider acceptance/delivery evidence

cases.name: cross-tenant access

cases.name: change stream lost history
